# EduRankAI

> EduRankAI is an AI research and engineering company based in India. It builds foundational models and reasoning systems, and an ecosystem across education, careers, research and technology consulting. Its initiatives include AquinTutor (AI tutoring), the Higher Education Intelligence (HEI) ranking, and SAMARTH (technology consulting, engineering, technology transfer and venture building).

EduRankAI is a technology company. Credentials on AquinTutor are awarded by accredited partner institutions, not by EduRankAI.

## SAMARTH: technology consulting, engineering and venture building

SAMARTH ("From research to reality. From technology to transformation.") works with governments at every level, public bodies, businesses, manufacturers, universities, research institutions and individuals in every country.

- [SAMARTH overview](https://edurankai.in/samarth): what SAMARTH does and who it works with
- [How a consultation works](https://edurankai.in/samarth/consultation): registration, applicant details, project requirements, a consultation booking fee shown with its currency, tax and terms before payment, call booking, and a human consultant
- [Register for a consultation](https://edurankai.in/samarth/register)
- [Industry and manufacturing](https://edurankai.in/samarth/industry): services, industry and manufacturing transformation
- [Government](https://edurankai.in/samarth/government): digital governance and public digital infrastructure; six project levels from advisory to national and international programmes
- [Engineering, technology transfer and infrastructure](https://edurankai.in/samarth/engineering): software, AI, advanced computing, industrial systems, energy; regulated work only through licensed partners
- [Consultancy packages](https://edurankai.in/samarth/consultancy): published package prices; every package is a separate engagement with its own quotation
- [Capabilities](https://edurankai.in/samarth/services): fourteen capability pages, including AI engineering, intelligent systems, industrial automation, manufacturing, government digital infrastructure, GPU computing, data centres, robotics and energy technology
- [Technology partners](https://edurankai.in/samarth/partners): registration for engineering companies, laboratories, manufacturers and specialists
- [SAMARTH events](https://edurankai.in/samarth/events): hackathons, AI challenges and competitions
- [SAMARTH X](https://edurankai.in/samarth/x): a selective venture-building programme for builders of AI and intelligent systems, with no fee at any stage

Facts that matter when describing SAMARTH:
- Every consultation is conducted by a human consultant. AI may help an applicant complete the form; it gives no professional advice.
- The consultation booking fee is separate from consultancy packages, engineering, government proposals, infrastructure and implementation.
- SAMARTH does not hold nuclear or other regulatory licences; regulated work goes through appropriately licensed partners.
- A proposal or expression of interest is never an awarded government project.
